resolutions.researcher_notes: The flagged DEAD_LINK current_ref (al-mirbad/157543, dated 2 May 2024) re-verified live (verifier 200 + content present) — the failure was transient. It reports active advanced-stage construction ('العمل مستمر للمشروع وبمراحل متقدمة كنصب المعدات وإكمال الأعمال الميكانيكية'), consistent with Status='construction'. Independently corroborated: attaqa.net (Dec 2025) describes the project as still in an advanced execution phase progressing rapidly with initial operation targeted for Q1 2027; Egypt Oil & Gas (English) says the project 'nears operational phase' with equipment delivered and installation set to begin, not yet operational. Three independent outlets all place the project mid-construction (not operational), so Status='construction' is well supported. High.

No independent source corroborates ConstructionYear=2024 as the year construction STARTED; the evidence points earlier and CONTRADICTS 2024 as a start year. Baker Hughes/BHGE won the SGC contract in Aug 2018; per S&P Global / Oil&Gas Middle East reporting, agreements were signed 2021 and construction started ~2022. al-mirbad/132346 (dated 20 Feb 2023) reports the project already 47% complete, and al-mirbad/157476 & /157543 (May 2024) show equipment/civil installation still ongoing in 2024. So 2024 at best reflects construction still in progress, not its start. The single staged ref (al-mirbad/157543) documents active pipeline/equipment construction during 2024 but does not corroborate '2024' as a start year (contains_value=false). RECOMMEND: review ConstructionYear — construction start is better characterized as ~2022. Left UNRESOLVED for the value as stated.

Operator = South Gas Company (شركة غاز الجنوب) is strongly corroborated by multiple independent sources. al-mirbad/157543 (Arabic) repeatedly attributes the Nasiriyah & Gharraf gas investment project to شركة غاز الجنوب ('التابعة إلى شركة غاز الجنوب'). Baker Hughes' own press release headlines 'SGC awards BHGE contract' where SGC = South Gas Company. Egypt Oil & Gas (English) names 'South Gas Company' as the developer working with Baker Hughes. Three independent sources agree. High. Arabic operator name شركة غاز الجنوب confirmed by the al-mirbad source.
